perspective:
Bradley Ochoa’s available information:

- He is a salesperson at a marketing firm. Katherine Lasiloo is his colleague and the marketing manager. He experiences their professional relationship as cordial but sometimes strained by differing views on sales and marketing strategy.
- In the meeting room, he prepared data and charts from the last five campaigns to support traditional sales techniques. He believed traditional methods were being overlooked in favor of digital strategies. He heard Katherine acknowledge his point, say the market is evolving, argue digital outreach has potential, and suggest analyzing data together to integrate both approaches.
- After the meeting, Katherine shared recent digital-campaign success stories that boosted engagement and sales. This made Bradley uncertain and caused him to question his prior reliance on only traditional methods. He asked Katherine to explain how digital strategies are developed. He heard her discuss targeting the right audience with the right message and offer to walk him through analytics and decision-making. He admitted his doubts and interest in learning more; she encouraged adapting and going deeper into the data.
- He later proposed a joint strategy session to combine traditional and digital marketing. Katherine agreed, saying combining strengths could improve results and suggesting a brainstorming/outlining session. He expressed hope and appreciation; she said she looked forward to leveraging each other’s strengths.
- After the joint meeting, he was excited and worked overtime on a board presentation draft integrating both their ideas. He showed it to Katherine; she praised it as comprehensive and well thought out. He said he was convinced the integrated approach would set them apart and wanted to nail the presentation; she suggested fine-tuning it.
- After the presentation and implementation, he felt grateful for professional growth and successful collaboration. He thanked Katherine and proposed regular strategy sessions. Katherine said the project had come to fruition, his openness helped make the partnership successful, and regular sessions would keep them on top of their game and market trends.
- He does not have access to Katherine’s private thoughts, hidden motivations, narrator-only labels, or information she never told him and he did not observe.
